title: The fake mast in a van (SMS blaster)
format: Threat story, HSERIA + CTA, second person, rule book v8 (format A)

lines.text: This scam text never touched your network.

lines.text: Saturday, Oxford Street. Your phone buzzes.

lines.text: HMRC says you're owed a refund. Tap to claim.

lines.text: Parked nearby is a van. Inside it, a fake phone mast.

lines.text: On Android, open Settings. Search 2G. Turn off Allow 2G.
